jobs.title: Manager, Business Modelling & Strategy - Quick Commerce
jobs.description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Quick commerce sits at the heart of our organisation's strategy. This role supports the maths behind that growth. You will build the models that turn a wide set of initiatives & drivers - basket size, order frequency, cost per order, assortment mix, store throughput, promotional spend - into one cohesive narrative.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own the numbers end to end. Build and maintain projections, unit economics, ROI cases and scenario plans for new initiatives, store formats and commercial levers.

- Break problems into levers and reconnect them. Size each driver individually, then wire them into a single output, so a change in any input flows through to contribution, margin or growth without manual rework.

- Pressure-test your own assumptions. Ground the model in real data, and be candid about which inputs are solid and which are educated guesses.

- Build workflows at scale. Deep Excel plus AI tooling - LLM-based automation, scripting, low-code - so recurring analysis runs itself.

- Turn output into a decision. Say what we should do, what it costs, what it returns, and what would have to be true for it to fail.

- Support budget planning and resource allocation discussions through analysis and recommendations to help meet growth and profitability targets

- Drive coordination, analysis, progress tracking, and follow-up for the company’s OKR process

- Actively engage and participate in key regular touchpoints: performance updates, financial reviews, budgeting & strategy, etc.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU WILL BRING

- 3–6 years in strategy, consulting, investment banking or private equity, commercial finance, or a modelling-heavy role in a high-growth operating business.

- Deep Excel knowledge - ability to build financial models & scenarios with logical assumptions.

- Hands-on use of AI tools to automate analytical work. SQL and/or Python is a strong plus.

- Structured problem solving: you can take a vague question and reach a defensible answer.

- The judgement to know when an estimate is good enough to decide on, and when it is not.

- Comfortable reading and interpreting financial documents, including country P&Ls and investment proposals, and deriving actions from them.

Unfiltered Authenticity: AI can automate speed and polish, but it can't automate real human contribution. We foster a culture of direct feedback and raw authenticity because the unique edge you bring is our greatest competitive advantage.

Assisterende Butikksjef – foodora market Trondheim

Er du klar for å bli en av våre fremtidige butikksjefer?

Hos foodora market tror vi på å utvikle egne ledere. Mange av våre ledere startet som Pickers eller Låseansvarlige. Felles for dem er at de tok ansvar, skapte resultater og hadde et ønske om å utvikle seg.

Nå ser vi etter vår neste Assisterende Butikksjef i Trondheim – en person som ønsker mer enn bare en jobb. En person som ønsker å utvikle mennesker, skape resultater og ta neste steg på sin lederreise.

Vi tror de beste lederne ikke nødvendigvis er de som løper raskest eller jobber hardest alene. Vi tror de er de som evner å få med seg folk, bygge sterke team og skape et miljø hvor mennesker trives, utvikler seg og leverer resultater sammen.

Hvis du motiveres av ansvar, utvikling, høyt tempo og muligheten til å påvirke både mennesker og resultater, ønsker vi å høre fra deg.

Om rollen

Som Assisterende Butikksjef er du butikkens nestleder og en viktig støttespiller for Butikksjefen.

Sammen har dere ansvaret for butikkens drift, medarbeidere, kultur og resultater.

Du skal bidra til at teamet lykkes hver eneste dag, samtidig som du sikrer at butikkens mål, standarder og kundeopplevelse leveres på et høyt nivå.

Dette er en rolle for deg som trives med ansvar, liker å utvikle mennesker og ønsker å være med på å skape resultater gjennom et sterkt team og god drift.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver

● Bidra til å sikre effektiv og lønnsom drift av butikken

● Lede, motivere og utvikle medarbeidere i det daglige

● Sørge for at teamet leverer høy kvalitet og gode kundeopplevelser

● Følge opp butikkens KPI-er og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring

● Planlegge og disponere ressurser gjennom dagen

● Delta i rekruttering, onboarding og opplæring av nye medarbeidere

● Bidra til å bygge en sterk prestasjons- og forbedringskultur

● Gjennomføre oppfølging, coaching og utvikling av medarbeidere

● Sikre etterlevelse av rutiner, prosesser og HMS

● Støtte Butikksjefen i den daglige ledelsen av butikken

● Ta ansvar for butikken når Butikksjefen ikke er til stede

jobs.description:
foodora is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 65+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

We are on the lookout for a Senior Legal Counsel, EU Employment Law to join the Legal Team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

Join the team that protects and enables Delivery Hero’s growth. In the Legal Team, you’ll support key initiatives by providing proactive legal guidance that aligns business goals with regulatory standards. Your work will help mitigate risks and ensure we’re positioned for sustainable, long-term success—making you a key contributor to our mission of delivering amazing experiences worldwide.

As a Senior Legal Counsel, you will advise Delivery Hero on employment law challenges related to platform work across the world. Our ideal candidate is a seasoned employment lawyer with litigation experience, passionate about the gig economy, and excited to help shape the future of work.

About the opportunity

-
Lead the management of platform worker and rider classification risks globally, working closely with international employment lawyers across the Group.

-
Monitor and manage high-profile litigation and regulatory investigations, and develop defense strategies in collaboration with local legal counsel.

-
Partner with Product, Tech, and Operations teams to deeply understand delivery operations and the tech stack, and support the development of next-generation delivery solutions.

-
Support cross-functional teams in exploring new business models and strategic opportunities related to platform work.

-
Track and analyze legislative and regulatory developments impacting platform work, and advise Public Policy teams at HQ and market level.

-
Act as a subject-matter expert, providing guidance to senior management and stakeholders across the Group, including availability for limited international travel (up to 10%).

-
Fully qualified employment lawyer in an EU jurisdiction, with extensive experience in employment law, including at least 6 years in a law firm environment and a strong background in litigation; prior in-house experience (1–3 years) is a plus.

-
Deep expertise in platform work and worker classification, with hands-on experience interpreting and applying the EU Platform Workers Directive and related employment legislation.

-
Strong legal judgment with the ability to influence, demonstrated through advising senior stakeholders and collaborating effectively across multi-jurisdictional and cross-functional teams.

-
Excellent communication and drafting skills, including experience in legal drafting, executive-level communication, and creating clear, compelling slide presentations.

-
Collaborative and impact-driven mindset, with hands-on experience thriving in fast-paced, evolving environments and contributing beyond defined role boundaries when needed.

-
Full professional proficiency in English (working language) and fluency in at least one additional European language, with willingness to be based in or relocate to one of our markets in the EU.

Problem Definition & Framing: Work directly with your PM and Engineering leads to translate user needs and business requirements into clear, validated design solutions.

User Research & Insights: Plan and execute evaluative user research (usability testing, user interviews) and utilize quantitative metrics to validate design hypotheses.

Design System Stewardship: Apply and advocate for our design system consistently across web and mobile experiences. Identify gaps, propose new components, and help evolve system patterns.

Systems & Edge Case Thinking: Design with a deep understanding of complex backend workflows, edge cases, offline states, and multi-step user journeys.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with developers during handoff and QA to ensure technical feasibility and craft quality during release.

jobs.title: Workforce Planning Manager
jobs.description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

We are seeking for a Workforce Planning Manager to own workforce and personnel-cost planning for an assigned business, country, function or multi-market scope. Working closely with People, Finance and business stakeholders, you will lead planning cycles, challenge assumptions, reconcile workforce and financial plans, and turn workforce data into clear scenarios and recommendations for business decisions. You will play a key role in strengthening planning standards, data quality and alignment between People and Finance.

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end workforce planning for the assigned scope across annual budget, forecasts and multi-year planning cycles.

- Lead planning discussions with People, Finance and business stakeholders, challenging assumptions and driving alignment on headcount, capacity and personnel costs.

- Act as a subject-matter expert on workforce-planning standards, including positions, vacancies, hires, exits, compensation, transfers, recharges and restructuring impacts.

- Manage workforce assumptions and movements in Anaplan WFP and ensure alignment with the P&L module in partnership with Finance.

- Own WFP-to-P&L reconciliations, investigate variances and drive timely resolution of data or process issues.

- Lead monthly workforce performance reviews, explaining headcount and personnel-cost variances and highlighting key risks and opportunities.

- Develop workforce scenarios and sensitivities covering growth, attrition, vacancies, compensation, productivity and restructuring, and translate findings into clear recommendations.

- Maintain workforce reports and dashboards, ensuring data quality, consistency and traceability across Anaplan, Workday/HRIS and Finance sources.

- Identify planning risks and dependencies, drive follow-ups and ensure actions, approvals and deadlines are completed.

- Lead selected process improvements, including planning standards, controls, documentation, testing and adoption of workforce-planning tools.

- Provide functional guidance and quality review to analysts and planning contributors where required.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- 4–7 years of experience in workforce planning, HR controlling, FP&A, people analytics, financial planning or a similar analytical discipline.

- Experience owning workforce or financial planning processes across a complex business, function, country or multi-market scope.

- Strong knowledge of headcount and position management, budgeting, forecasting, personnel-cost planning, variance analysis and P&L.

- Hands-on experience with Anaplan or a comparable enterprise planning platform, including planning cycles, scenarios, inputs, outputs and reconciliations.

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with the ability to structure, validate and analyse large datasets and create clear decision materials.

- Strong ability to connect HR and organisational changes to financial impact and translate analysis into clear options, risks and recommendations.

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and drive alignment without formal authority.

- Highly structured, detail-oriented and proactive, with strong ownership and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

- High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive employee, organisational and financial data.

- Fluent English communication skills, written and verbal.

Nice to have:

- Workday experience, particularly organisational structures, position management and headcount movements.

- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL or similar data and visualisation tools.

- Experience working in a multi-country or matrix organisation with People and Finance stakeholders.

- Experience supporting reorganisations, restructuring, productivity or workforce-transformation initiatives.

- Experience providing functional guidance, quality review or coaching to analysts.

In the context of “giving users easy access to anything in their city”, Q-commerce (Quick Commerce) is the business unit that aims to provide immediacy to all product needs that a user might have, from delivering a video game to sending a gift... to filling up their fridge. We do that through 3 verticals: Groceries with Partners, Groceries with our own Micro Fulfillment Centers (MFCs), and Retail Shops.

The Q-commerce team is organized into 3 verticals: Groceries through Partners, Retail, and Groceries through Micro Fulfillment Centers - MFCs, our very own supermarkets.

As part of the HQ Category Management team, you will be responsible for creating, testing, and implementing new pricing and promotional strategies for our MFCs. This is a position in the team that comes with a complex equation to solve: to use data to define the MFC ideal product pricing strategy, balancing attractiveness and profitability in a channel in which the rules of the pricing game are not defined yet.

You will help to create the process needed to evolve from a basic margin-driven approach to a dynamic pricing strategy. This includes managing the relationship with web-scraping solutions, building tools for local teams, and using data to evaluate the current pricing and promotions strategy to continuously improve it. You will also be in contact with the central team members of Delivery Hero to adopt their business solutions adapting them to Glovo’s needs if necessary.

You will:

-
Being responsible for the overall product pricing and promotions playbook, working closely together with the Data Analytics, Growth, and Local teams.

-
Structure and shape pricing initiatives, both strategic and operational. Develop project plans, gather and synthesize relevant data, lead analyses, and develop final recommendations.

-
Design experiments - including A/B testing when applicable - and interpret the results together with the Data team to draw detailed and actionable conclusions.

-
Drive clarity and solve ambiguous, challenging business problems using data-driven approaches.

-
Lead change management and migration to Delivery Hero business solutions.

As a member of the central Data Platform tribe, you’ll drive the product vision, strategy, and execution of DH's global core infrastructure and data products, supporting thousands of internal users on leveraging data to provide an amazing experience for millions of customers across 70+ countries.

As the Senior Product Manager for Core Data, you won't just manage global data models and products: You will own the global blueprint for how Delivery Hero understands and measures its business. You will bridge the gap between local brand nuances (like foodpanda, Glovo, or Talabat) and a unified global data product portfolio that empowers teams and users across the globe to operate with consistent definitions and reliable insights.

This role requires a strong understanding of DH’s business operations and data landscape, exceptional stakeholder alignment skills, and hands-on analytical expertise to understand the status and quality of our core data. You will work closely with local data teams and global services to align on scalable data models that address critical business challenges, while partnering internally with your Core Data team to deliver high-impact data products built on those foundations.

You will play a key role in shaping a data ecosystem that processes millions of events every day. Your success will be measured by the reliability and impact of your global data products.

In this role you will,

-
Own the Vision: Define and execute the roadmap for Core Data products, moving us from fragmented local silos and inconsistent data definitions to a high-performance global standard.

-
Scale Global Models: Partner with local data teams and central global services to align on data models that solve high-stakes business issues across DH’s key processes (Search and Recommendation, Order Processing, Finance, Marketing…).

-
Lead a Power Squad: Drive a cross-functional team of Data Engineers and Analysts. You aren't just a "backlog manager"; you are the bridge that translates business intent into technical architecture and drives execution.

-
Guardian of Quality: Implement federated data governance processes. When data quality dips, you don't just fix it: You build the systems that prevent it from happening again.

jobs.description:

Butikksjef – foodora market Bergen

Vil du bygge et lag som vinner – hver eneste dag?

De beste lederne skaper ikke resultater alene.

De bygger sterke team. De utvikler mennesker. De setter standarden for kulturen rundt seg. Og de skaper et miljø hvor mennesker gleder seg til å komme på jobb og levere sitt beste.

Hos foodora market tror vi at de beste lederne er de som evner å få med seg folk, skape energi og få teamet til å yte litt mer enn de trodde de kunne.

Nå søker vi vår neste Butikksjef til Bergen – en person som ønsker mer enn bare en lederrolle. En person som ønsker å bygge et lag, utvikle fremtidige ledere og skape resultater gjennom mennesker.

Hvis du motiveres av ansvar, ledelse og resultater, kan dette være rollen for deg.

Om rollen

Som Butikksjef har du det overordnede ansvaret for butikkens drift, medarbeidere, kultur og resultater.

Du er ansvarlig for å skape et miljø hvor medarbeidere trives, utvikler seg og leverer sitt beste hver dag. Samtidig sikrer du at butikkens KPI-er, kundeopplevelse og operasjonelle standarder holder et høyt nivå.

Du blir målt på resultater, men du lykkes først og fremst gjennom menneskene rundt deg.

Dette er rollen for deg som ønsker å bygge en sterk kultur, utvikle mennesker og skape resultater i et av Norges mest moderne retail- og logistikkonsepter.

Dine ansvarsområderLedelse og kultur

- Lede, motivere og utvikle butikkens medarbeidere

- Bygge en sterk kultur preget av energi, ansvar og lagspill

- Gjennomføre oppfølging, coaching og medarbeidersamtaler

- Rekruttere, utvikle og beholde talentfulle medarbeidere

- Skape et arbeidsmiljø hvor mennesker trives og presterer

- Identifisere og utvikle fremtidige ledere

Drift og gjennomføring

- Sikre effektiv drift og høy operasjonell standard

- Sørge for høy kvalitet på kundebestillinger og kundeopplevelser

- Sikre etterlevelse av rutiner, prosesser og HMS

- Planlegge og disponere ressurser på best mulig måte

- Identifisere og gjennomføre forbedringstiltak

- Sikre at butikken leverer på selskapets mål og forventninger

Resultater og forretningsforståelse

- Følge opp butikkens KPI-er og målsettinger

- Analysere resultater og omsette innsikt til handling

- Sikre produktivitet, kvalitet og lønnsom drift

- Bygge en prestasjonskultur med fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring

- Ta eierskap til butikkens resultater og utvikling
jobs.requirements_raw:
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som elsker å utvikle mennesker og som motiveres av å skape resultater gjennom teamet ditt.

Vi tror du:

- Har ledererfaring fra retail, logistikk, service eller lignende

- Har erfaring med personalansvar og teamutvikling

- Har evnen til å engasjere og få med deg mennesker

- Er trygg, tydelig og tillitsskapende som leder

- Kombinerer høye forventninger med støtte og utvikling

- Trives med ansvar og eierskap

- Har sterk gjennomføringsevne

- Motiveres av mål, KPI-er og kontinuerlig forbedring

- Evner å balansere drift, mennesker og resultater

- Er positiv, energisk og løsningsorientert

- Trives med høyt tempo og evner å holde hodet kaldt når det koker rundt deg

- Liker å være tett på både mennesker og drift

Hva gjør rollen unik?

Hos foodora market er ledelse en operativ disiplin.

Du leder ikke fra et kontor. Du leder gjennom tilstedeværelse, energi og handling.

Noen dager handler om coaching, utviklingssamtaler og kulturbygging. Andre dager handler om å løse utfordringer i sanntid, støtte teamet på gulvet og sikre at driften flyter når tempoet er på sitt høyeste.

Vi kan ikke love medlemskap på treningssenter, men vi kan love at smartklokken din kommer til å få kjørt seg. En rolig dag hos oss kan fort bety rundt 20.000 skritt.

Hvis du liker å være tett på både mennesker og drift, vil du trives hos oss.

Hos oss får du

- Ansvar for din egen butikk og dine egne resultater

- Muligheten til å bygge og utvikle ditt eget team

- Stor påvirkningskraft på kultur, drift og resultater

- En sentral lederrolle i et selskap i sterk vekst

- Verdifull erfaring innen ledelse, drift og forretningsutvikling

- Et ungt, energisk og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

- Konkurransedyktige betingelser

- Muligheten til å utvikle deg videre i foodora

Vi er alltid på jakt etter nye superhelter som bidrar med positivitet, energi og et ønske om å utvikle seg. Som Butikksjef får du muligheten til å sette ditt preg på både mennesker, kultur og resultater – og være med på å utvikle fremtidens ledere i foodora market.

jobs.title: Head of Regulation, AML and Compliance - DH Pay
jobs.description:
Delivery Hero Payments S.A. is a licensed payment institution based in Greece, enabling digital payment and merchant settlement operations for our affiliated EU marketplace platforms across the Delivery Hero group, that includes leading marketplace brands like eFood, Foody, Foodora, etc.. We operate at scale, processing high marketplace volumes, while maintaining a clearly defined intragroup operating scope focused on governance, security, compliance, operational excellence, risk management and at the same time act as enablers of the fintech strategy of the Group with services aiming both consumers and vendors.

We are now looking for a Head of AML, Regulatory and Compliance, to join us and take over this challenge at our Athens based office. The role includes responsibility for our licensed payment institution's AML, Regulatory and Compliance affairs, overseeing of all compliance matters of the firm, including matters relating to anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing (AML/CTF), licensing requirements, sanctions compliance, third-party risk management, and communication with the local regulator and/or other regulatory authorities involved in our operations.

This is a high-impact role reporting to the Managing Director of the firm as well as to the Board of Directors, following the applicable regulatory guidelines.

What you’ll do

-
Lead the development, gap analysis, implementation, and ongoing monitoring/management of a comprehensive compliance program, inter alia related to Payment Services Directives 2 and 3 (PSD2/PSD3), Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Terrorist Financing (AML/CTF), Card Scheme Compliance, compliance enterprise risk assessments, fraud, anti-bribery and corruption, conflicts of interest, data privacy regulations, cybersecurity regulations, industry’s best practices and regulator’s specific guidelines to protect customer data and streamline financial transactions.

-
Build, execute, and maintain a comprehensive fit-for-purpose AML program that is aligned with the firm's expectations, regulatory guidelines and European (AMLA) compliance developments (RTS) related to our business and oversee all aspects of AML compliance, including:

-
AML risk assessment

-
Evaluation and update of internal Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Know Your Customer (KYC) policies and procedures

-
Transaction and account monitoring

-
Enhanced due diligence and Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR)

-
Screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media, applicable local lists)

-
Regulatory reporting

-
Training on AML policies and guidelines.

-
Promoting a group wide AML/KYC compliance culture by interacting with various stakeholders across levels.

-
Lead any regulatory assessment related to the maintenance and expansion of scope of our payments business, effective distillery of regulatory requirements and translation into business language and practical action plans, coordinate periodic internal and external audits, relevant findings’ management, third-party inquiries, substantial experience on working closely with regulators to ensure the company is compliant.

-
Contribute to the passporting expansion of the payment services to other European countries to secure all fillings’ and associated documentation content compliance with regulatory prerequisites, development and implementation of new payment products and services (e-wallets, buy now pay later, etc.), assess and advise on tooling choices, and contribute to cross-departmental projects providing compliance advice and guidance to relevant stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Product, Operations).

-
Effective monitor wider governance matters by contributing to the periodic Board and General Assembly Minutes, contract reviews or commenting, as well as other regulatory input to ensure that necessary compliance language is properly addressed, and handle ad hoc regulatory/governance requests (e.g. fit and proper questionnaires, asset declarations, etc).

-
Champion a strong culture of compliance within the organization, fostering a risk-aware environment while ensuring innovation coincides with responsible practices.

-
Stay up-to-date on evolving regulations and emerging technologies in the fintech space, proactively identifying potential impacts and implementing necessary program updates in all applicable areas of responsibility and jurisdictions.
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
University Degree in Law, Economics, or a related field.

-
8+ years of AML, regulatory and/or compliance experience, in a financial institution (e.g. Bank, PI, eMI, other). Additional experience in advisory practice and/or CAMS or other AML certification is a strong plus.

-
Ability to effectively manage directly a team of people working in AML and regulatory affairs while also cooperating with cross-functional teams and senior executives from diverse backgrounds and disciplines.

-
Proven track record in developing, implementing, and managing AML programs and overseeing compliance projects and assurance services (audit or similar) in the financial services industry.

-
Experience managing relationships and effectively handling communications with regulatory authorities.

-
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, along with ability to perform under pressure in a dynamic and diverse environment.

-
Excellent command of Greek and English (written and spoken).

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist – CRM
jobs.description:

We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Are you passionate about turning users into loyal, repeat customers — and driving growth through data-driven marketing?

Let's talk!

Our Marketing team is looking for a highly motivated Performance Marketing Specialist – CRM to join our CRM function within Performance Marketing. You'll follow the same rituals as the rest of the team — campaign planning, weekly reporting, and a continuous test-execute-report-retest cycle.

This isn't email marketing. At efood, CRM is a performance channel: a mix of email, push notifications, SMS, in-app messages, and in-product visibility, all pointed at one goal — driving retention (and a slice of acquisition, through onboarding and activation). Vouchers are an extra incentive layer used to boost incrementality through these channels for specific segments, and managing that budget is a core skill in its own right. Segmentation and rigorous evaluation decide which channel, incentive and budget combination gets used for which user group — this is a role for someone who takes a performance approach to spend allocation, not just campaign content.

You'll be working with 2.5M+ active users in a 6-month period and high interaction frequency — meaning your decisions get tested against real business results almost instantly.

What you'll do:

-
Own the full campaign cycle within CRM — strategy, execution, reporting, evaluation, retest — with fast, at-scale feedback

-
Decide the right mix of channels (email, push, in-app messages, SMS, in-product visibility) per user segment, and applying a performance approach to how budget is split

-
Focus on driving incrementality — testing whether a voucher is actually needed to move a segment, or whether comms alone achieve the same result, so incentive spend only goes where it changes behavior

-
Address all critical user lifecycle stages — onboarding, activation, retention, reactivation, win-back — through ongoing cross-channel communication

-
Define, track and report on retention and business KPIs (repeat purchase rate, D30/D90 retention, LTV) and translate results into concrete business decisions, not just campaign learnings

-
Own the performance of voucher-led incentives — sizing, targeting and budget included — treating incentive spend as a lever to optimize, not a fixed cost

-
Plan, execute and document A/B tests within CRM channels, and participate in Performance Marketing's shared reporting and optimization rituals

-
Own campaign-level reporting and evaluation, presenting results in business terms that inform decisions beyond the CRM team

-
Collaborate with the Business Intelligence team to analyze customer behavior and refine segmentation and targeting logic

-
Actively participate in budget planning, treating voucher and incentive spend as a business investment with measurable ROI

-
Research and develop best practices and automations that elevate campaign management and efficiency

Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute with creative ideas grounded in business impact, not just engagement

Experience managing budget or incentive spend (vouchers, promotions) with a performance mindset — testing and optimizing the split, not just executing it

-
Strong familiarity with user retention & growth strategies in a digital environment, across multiple channels — not solely email

-
Segmentation experience used to decide how and where to reach users, not just to personalize messaging

-
Experience with campaign analysis and building reports that drive business decisions, not just describe results

Monitor changes in Polish tax law and accounting regulations to ensure ongoing compliance.

Collaboration & Audit

Liaison for Group Finance: Cooperate with local Finance Team and Regional Controllers and HQ regarding Group reporting and policy alignment.

-

-
Support the Head of Finance in ad-hoc financial analysis and local treasury/cash-flow management.

Process Excellence & Leadership

-
Supervision: Guide and review the work of junior team members or external accounting partners, ensuring high-quality output.

Automation: Drive initiatives to standardize and automate accounting processes (e.g., ERP improvements).

Maintain and update internal accounting procedures and control frameworks.

You will be managing senior relationships with major national brands, running structured business reviews, identifying growth opportunities, and executing the levers that move performance. You will also be the internal coordinator when things need to get done — working across Finance, Operations, Ads, and Marketing to make sure what is agreed actually happens.

The role rewards people who combine strong commercial judgment with the discipline to stay on top of the detail. Both matter here.

What You Will Do

-
Own the relationship: You are the primary point of contact for your portfolio. You build trust with your partners' key stakeholders, understand their business priorities, and manage the relationship proactively — not just at review time.

-
Lead business reviews: You prepare and deliver MBRs and QBRs end-to-end: clear narrative, data-backed, with a concrete action plan. You run the conversation, not just the presentation.

-
Monitor and act on performance: You track how your accounts are performing across key metrics, and bring a point of view and a recommendation when something needs to change.

-
Execute the commercial agenda: You manage promotional activations, advertising commitments, and marketing initiatives. You identify opportunities to grow the partnership and pursue them at the right moment with a well-framed pitch.

-
Coordinate internally: You are the person who makes sure commitments to partners get delivered. That means working cross-functionally to resolve issues — billing, operations, campaign execution, etc. — and keeping partners informed throughout.

-
Build commercial proposals: You prepare structured materials to support growth conversations: account plans, opportunity analysis, investment cases. You think ahead and bring that thinking to your partners.

What Makes This Role Distinctive

-
Small portfolio, high stakes: You manage a small number of major national accounts. The relationships are deep, the conversations are substantive, and your impact is directly visible.

-
Real commercial scope: This is not a maintenance role. You will be involved in promotional strategy, investment discussions, and growth planning with some of the most important restaurant brands in Spain.

-
High standards, fast feedback: as any team at Glovo, the XL team operates with a very high bar for preparation and follow-through. You will be expected to meet it — and you will find the environment sharper for it.
jobs.requirements_raw:

-
Commercial acumen: You know how to build a case, read a room, and move a conversation forward. You are comfortable in senior commercial discussions and have a track record of driving outcomes in complex, high-value relationships.

-
Strong communication: You present with confidence and structure - write with clarity, and adapt your style to the audience. You are direct without being blunt, and persuasive without overselling.

-
Structured and reliable: You manage a demanding workload without losing track of the detail. Partners and internal teams know that when you own something, it gets done.

+4 years in senior account management or commercial client-facing roles: Background in food delivery, marketplace platforms, FMCG, or high-growth tech is a strong plus. What matters is that you have managed significant accounts and driven commercial outcomes independently.

Full professional proficiency in Spanish and English, both written and verbal.

You will join Data Platform Enablement, the central team responsible for maintaining and governing Glovo's data tools, defining data governance standards and automating the processes that keep our data ecosystem trustworthy and efficient.

jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

-
2-3 years of hands-on experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics, BI, Data Engineering or a similar technical data role.

-
Strong SQL foundations, with the ability to independently write, debug and optimise analytical queries.

-
Working proficiency in Python to support data analysis, automation and workflow improvements.

-
Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and collaborative engineering practices (pull requests, code reviews, version control).

-
Practical experience leveraging LLMs and/or automation tools (n8n, Make, APIs) to streamline processes.

-
An ambitious and independent mindset, comfortable owning well-scoped tasks, while still developing towards fully independent end-to-end project ownership.

-
English proficiency: Good communication in English, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

Nice to have:

-
Exposure to Google Cloud Platform, infrastructure/cost monitoring or governance.

-
Exposure to Looker or other modern BI tools; interest in conversational analytics.

-
Interest in mentoring, delegating or project management, as a possible path towards people leadership.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first months, success will mean:

-
You understand the main data assets, tools and workflows used by the team.

-
You can contribute to simple data transformations and documentation with guidance.

-
You can validate outputs and raise quality concerns when something does not look right.

-
You use AI-enabled tools responsibly to support your work, without blindly trusting the results.

-
You start connecting business problems with reliable data solutions.

-
You show curiosity, ownership and willingness to learn from feedback.

Over time, you will grow towards owning small data products independently and contributing to AI-enabled data initiatives with increasing autonomy.

IMPORTANT NOTE

This is not a pure AI Engineer role.

This is an Analytics Engineer I role within Data Enablement, with an expectation that the person will progressively develop AI competencies as part of the natural evolution of Analytics Engineering.

We believe AI will increasingly become part of how data teams work, but the foundation remains the same: trusted data, strong engineering practices, business understanding and responsible delivery.

jobs.description:

You will own the challenge of transforming our QA framework from an auditing function into an active, data-driven engine that predicts quality defects before they impact the customer. You will bridge cross-border execution with regional strategy, leveraging analytical rigor to build scalable quality processes that drive continuous improvement and customer satisfaction across hubs.

THE JOURNEY

-
Lead Multi-Hub Quality Strategy: Own the end-to-end quality framework and audit strategy across our BPO partner hubs, ensuring processes are standardized, scalable, and globally aligned.

-
Execute Continuous Improvement: Lead root-cause analyses to identify systemic process gaps, launching targeted improvement initiatives that directly boost customer satisfaction and SLA compliance.

-
Establish Closed-Loop Quality Frameworks: Feed quality audit insights directly back into recruitment profiling, onboarding curricula, and ongoing coaching mechanisms to proactively address recurring performance gaps.

-
Drive Regional Calibration & Consistency: Host structured, cross-site calibration sessions with BPO leads and auditors to minimize scoring variance and maintain consistent evaluation standards across geographies

Partner Cross-Functionally for Operational Scale: Collaborate closely with Regional Service Delivery Heads, Training leads, and external BPO operational managers to align operational priorities, resolve risks, and execute strategic regional initiatives.

3 to 5 years of Quality Operations experience in fast-paced, tech-driven customer service, hospitality, or BPO environments, with a proven track record designing evaluation frameworks, running calibrations, and conducting root-cause analyses.

Lean Six Sigma Yellow or Green Belt certification or formal methodology training to independently execute process improvement projects and cycles.

Closed-loop quality vision and project management capability (PMP or equivalent appreciated) to manage multi-month initiatives and integrate QA insights directly into coaching mechanisms, recruitment profiling and training programs.

Vendor governance and risk modeling experience, with a background using leading indicators to spot quality defects before they impact customers and background auditing outsourced BPO performance.

Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish (C1/C2) to manage cross-border hubs, lead regional reviews, and align with global leadership (Portuguese proficiency is a strong plus).

Independent SQL proficiency with the ability to write standalone queries to extract, merge, and clean raw transaction and audit datasets without relying on data engineering.

On a chapter level, you are a key contributor to the evolution of your Chapter Vision & Strategy. You sponsor and drive the key Chapter initiatives and orchestrate mentorship efforts across the wider tech org.

On a tech org level, you contribute to the improvement of overall developer experience, from branding initiatives/hiring to helping individuals and teams be more effective. You critically question and drive improvement across the org.

We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Ref ID: JR0085714

About the Role

We are looking for a data-driven operations professional with a strong background in Business Performance or Business Analytics. This role owns the operational performance of foodpanda's Quick Commerce Shops portfolio by analysing KPIs, identifying root causes, building dashboards and leading cross-functional improvement initiatives to deliver measurable business impact.

This role is expected to independently own operational outcomes across the Shops portfolio, lead cross-functional initiatives, manage complex operational projects with minimal supervision, and proactively identify opportunities to improve operational performance at scale.

Key Responsibilities

1. Shops Performance Management.

- Own the operational performance of the QC Shops portfolio across Bangladesh.

- Monitor, analyse and improve operational performance across key business and fulfilment metrics including: Item Not Found (InF), Vendor Offline Rate, Vendor Fail Rate, Perfect Fulfilment Rate (PFR), Order Acceptance Rate, Cancellation Rate, Replacement Offered %, Picker Utilisation, Orchestration SKU Coverage & Stock and assortment availability

- Identify operational risks and recurring performance issues through data analysis.

- Perform root cause analyses and develop structured action plans to improve vendor performance.

- Partner closely with Account Managers to implement operational improvement initiatives for underperforming vendors.

- Conduct joint vendor visits where required to validate operational issues and ensure agreed actions are implemented.

- Measure, monitor and report the business impact of operational improvement initiatives.

2. Strategic Retail Partner Expansion

- Lead the operational execution of strategic retail partner launches from planning through post-launch stabilisation.

- Coordinate operational readiness across Operations, Commercial, Account Management and partner teams.

- Manage launch timelines, dependencies, risks and stakeholder communication.

- Coordinate picker onboarding, training, deployment and operational readiness for new strategic partner launches.

- Ensure operational processes and SOPs are successfully implemented before and after launch.

- Monitor launch performance and drive corrective actions where required.

- Continuously improve the operating model for strategic retail partners as the business scales.

3. Picker Operations & Inventory Coordination

- Coordinate operational readiness of foodpanda picker teams supporting Shops operations.

- Monitor picker training-to-deployment readiness.

- Identify stores, categories and SKUs requiring inventory verification based on operational data.

- Define inventory count priorities and provide clear guidance to picker teams on execution.

- Monitor inventory check completion, quality and follow-up actions.

- Partner with Account Managers and picker teams to improve stock accuracy, assortment availability and InF performance.

4. Field Operations & Store Excellence

- Conduct regular field visits to partner stores to validate operational performance, identify root causes and ensure sustainable improvements are embedded across the vendor network.

- Observe fulfilment processes including picking, packing and order handover.

- Validate compliance with operational SOPs and foodpanda standards.

- Deliver operational coaching and guidance to vendor teams and picker teams.

- Document findings, assign corrective actions and ensure timely follow-up.

- Support live operational escalations where required while maintaining focus on long-term operational improvement.

5. Data Analytics & Business Performance

- Analyse operational datasets to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.

- Build and maintain operational dashboards and recurring reports using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets to support faster decision-making and proactive performance management.

- Support analysis using SQL, Looker or other business intelligence tools where applicable.

- Prepare weekly and monthly business reviews for leadership.

- Translate data into actionable recommendations and measurable improvement plans.

- Track the effectiveness of operational initiatives and continuously optimize performance.

6. Operational Excellence & Regional Collaboration

- Partner with Regional Operations teams to identify best practices, operating models and successful initiatives across Delivery Hero markets.

- Evaluate, localise and implement regional initiatives within Bangladesh.

- Measure adoption and business impact of implemented initiatives, sharing learnings and recommendations where appropriate.

- Support the rollout of new operational tools, product features and process improvements.

- Coordinate cross-functionally with Commercial, Account Management, Product, Logistics and Data teams.

- Develop and continuously improve operational SOPs, playbooks, trackers and training materials.

- Independently lead operational improvement projects from problem identification and solution design through implementation, stakeholder alignment and impact measurement.

- Act as the operational subject matter expert supporting the Account Management team in driving vendor performance improvements.
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Economics, Data Analytics or a related discipline.

- 4 – 5 years of experience in Business Performance, Business Analytics, Performance Management, Operations Analytics, Marketplace Analytics, E-commerce Operations or Quick Commerce. Experience owning KPIs and performance reporting is strongly preferred.

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets (Pivot, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH) experience building dashboards and performance reports, Strong data analysis and KPI management.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bangla.

- Demonstrated experience managing operational performance and delivering measurable business improvements.

- Experience with SQL, Looker, Tableau or similar business intelligence tools is preferred.

- Experience working with supermarkets, grocery retailers, marketplaces or FMCG partners is preferred.

- Strong analytical, project management and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and rapidly changing operational environment.

jobs.title: Operations Support Associate (Swedish-speaking)
jobs.description:
At foodora, we’re transforming how people access local stores - from supermarkets to specialty shops - through our Local Shops marketplace. We are looking for an Operations Support role based in Stockholm, Sweden to support Local Shops / Shops operations with recurring, manual, and data-heavy tasks. The role will focus on assortment management, data clean-ups, and operational support related to vendor setup and ongoing maintenance, enabling local Operations, Sales, and AM teams to focus on core commercial priorities.

We’re looking for a highly organized Swedish-speaking Local Shops Operations Support Associate to support day-to-day operational and data-related tasks for our Local Shops business. This role is key to ensuring accurate assortment management, smooth operational execution, and timely support during vendor onboarding and ongoing maintenance, helping our partners succeed on the platform.

What You’ll Do - Key responsibilities

-
Be responsible for preparing, cleaning, and validating product files to ensure they are ready for assortment setup/creation.

-
Contribute to the setup and updating of menu items or product listings (SKUs), including descriptions, images, and pricing accuracy.

-
Assist in promotion and content execution by helping with promotion setup, banner creation, and the creation and ongoing maintenance of tags

-
Support data and operations by performing vendor and product data clean-ups, troubleshooting barcode reports, and reviewing and supporting related operational requirements

-
Provide support to vendors and internal stakeholders by creating decks and operational materials, and by handling repetitive, rule-based operational tasks during onboarding processes

Highly organized and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership

-
Able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

-
You communicate fluently in English and Swedish, both verbally and in writing

-
Comfortable working with spreadsheets

-
Previous experience from an administrative, operations, or account support role is considered a plus

-
Strong experience in Excel and/or Google Sheets is considered a plus

jobs.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
jobs.description:
Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?

- Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country.

- Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics.

- Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence.

- Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth.

- Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals.

- Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality.

- Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence.

- Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality.

- Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate.

- Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations.

- Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations.

- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

- Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables.

- Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction.

- Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management.

- Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards.

- Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage.

- Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHAT DID WE ORDER?

- Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage

- Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture.

- Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making

- Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion

- Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary

- Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well

- Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel, EU Employment Law (Platform Workers)
jobs.description:
foodora is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 65+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

We are on the lookout for a Legal Counsel, EU Employment Law to join the Legal Team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

Join the team that protects and enables Delivery Hero’s growth. In the Legal Team, you’ll support key initiatives by providing proactive legal guidance that aligns business goals with regulatory standards. Your work will help mitigate risks and ensure we’re positioned for sustainable, long-term success—making you a key contributor to our mission of delivering amazing experiences worldwide.

As a Legal Counsel, you will advise Delivery Hero on employment law challenges related to platform work across the world. Our ideal candidate is a seasoned employment lawyer with litigation experience, passionate about the gig economy, and excited to help shape the future of work.

About the opportunity

-
Lead the management of platform worker and rider classification risks globally, working closely with international employment lawyers across the Group.

-
Monitor and manage high-profile litigation and regulatory investigations, and develop defense strategies in collaboration with local legal counsel.

-
Partner with Product, Tech, and Operations teams to deeply understand delivery operations and the tech stack, and support the development of next-generation delivery solutions.

-
Support cross-functional teams in exploring new business models and strategic opportunities related to platform work.

-
Track and analyze legislative and regulatory developments impacting platform work, and advise Public Policy teams at HQ and market level.

-
Act as a subject-matter expert, providing guidance to senior management and stakeholders across the Group, including availability for limited international travel (up to 10%).
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
Fully qualified employment lawyer in an EU jurisdiction, with extensive experience in employment law, including at least 3 years in a law firm environment and a strong background in litigation; prior in-house experience is a plus.

-
Deep expertise in platform work and worker classification, with hands-on experience interpreting and applying the EU Platform Workers Directive and related employment legislation.

-
Strong legal judgment with the ability to influence, demonstrated through advising senior stakeholders and collaborating effectively across multi-jurisdictional and cross-functional teams.

-
Excellent communication and drafting skills, including experience in legal drafting, executive-level communication, and creating clear, compelling slide presentations.

-
Collaborative and impact-driven mindset, with hands-on experience thriving in fast-paced, evolving environments and contributing beyond defined role boundaries when needed.

-
Full professional proficiency in English (working language) and fluency in at least one additional European language, with willingness to be based in or relocate to one of our markets in the EU.

jobs.title: IT Application Support Administrator I
jobs.description:
Hungerstation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

IT Application Support Administrator I

Company: HungerStation

Division: Technology

Department: IT Operations

Grade: IC1

Reports to: IT Operations Manager

Job Overview

The IT Application Support Administrator I is responsible for implementing, configuring, maintaining, and supporting HungerStation’s IT applications and systems. The role provides day-to-day technical assistance to end users, ensures the reliable operation of IT applications and computer systems, and supports the timely resolution of incidents and service requests. The position serves as a key point of contact for application-related support, helping to maintain smooth IT operations and minimize disruption to business activities.

Key Responsibilities

The IT Application Support Administrator I acts as a first point of contact for IT application administration, support, and operational requests. The role is responsible for supporting the installation, configuration, maintenance, monitoring, and reliable operation of IT applications and computer systems across the organization.

The role manages day-to-day application support activities, responds to operational requests, troubleshoots technical issues, and provides assistance to different user groups. This includes handling incoming calls, emails, messages, and helpdesk requests in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), work instructions, and established IT processes.

The position is responsible for investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents with the aim of restoring services as quickly as possible, preferably at the First Point of Contact (FPOC). This includes monitoring, tracking, updating, and appropriately escalating active tickets when issues cannot be resolved within the required support level or timeframe.

The IT Application Support Administrator I provides support for desktop applications, workstations, and internal IT systems, ensuring that issues are addressed efficiently and with minimal disruption to employees. The role also takes proactive measures to identify recurring problems, investigate their root causes, and contribute to preventing similar incidents from occurring in the future.

The role researches and identifies appropriate solutions to application and software-related issues and communicates effectively with end users to understand the nature of technical problems. This may involve asking targeted questions to identify the root cause, guiding users through troubleshooting steps by phone, email, chat, or in person, and assisting HungerStation employees with setting up IT applications and resolving technical issues.

Where an issue cannot be resolved directly, the IT Application Support Administrator I is responsible for escalating it to the appropriate internal teams, such as software development, infrastructure, or other specialized IT teams. The role requires the ability to prioritize and manage multiple open incidents and requests simultaneously while maintaining appropriate communication and follow-up with affected users.

The position is also responsible for installing, configuring, monitoring, and maintaining IT applications and computer systems across the organization. This includes supporting the rollout and implementation of new systems and internal applications, as well as assisting with patches and anti-virus deployment and management.

All IT requests, incidents, and relevant support activities must be accurately recorded and maintained within the designated ticketing system. The role is also responsible for creating and maintaining application documentation, process workflows, technical notes, and user or support manuals, ensuring documentation is updated whenever systems, processes, or configurations change.

The IT Application Support Administrator I contributes technical documentation and relevant specifications to support the planning, implementation, enhancement, or upgrade of IT applications and systems. The role works closely with other IT team members to ensure that technical knowledge is properly documented and accessible to support effective service delivery.

Governance and Resilience

The IT Application Support Administrator I is expected to follow all relevant company and IT policies, procedures, processes, work instructions, and service standards to ensure that daily activities are carried out in a controlled, consistent, and effective manner.

The role contributes to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement across IT support processes and practices, with the aim of improving service quality, efficiency, user experience, and operational effectiveness. The position is also expected to contribute to maintaining a high-performance working environment and consistently demonstrate and promote HungerStation’s values.

Main Contacts

The role works closely with internal stakeholders across HungerStation, including employees, IT Operations, Technology teams, software and application teams, and other relevant internal departments. Where required, the position may also communicate with external partners, vendors, and service providers to support the resolution of IT application and system-related issues.

Qualifications and Requirements

The ideal candidate should have one to two years of relevant experience in IT application support, IT helpdesk, system administration, technical support, or a related field.

The candidate should have a strong understanding of IT troubleshooting and problem-solving and be able to investigate issues, identify appropriate solutions, and make practical decisions when implementing workarounds to restore services. The role requires creative and analytical thinking to identify alternative solutions when standard troubleshooting approaches do not resolve an issue.

The candidate should be able to work effectively under pressure, manage multiple requests simultaneously, and prioritize assigned tasks according to business impact, urgency, and agreed service levels. Strong communication and customer-service skills are also important, as the role requires regular interaction with end users and internal stakeholders.

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical field is required.

Competencies

The role requires strong problem-solving, communication, customer service, collaboration, time management, adaptability, and prioritization skills. The candidate should demonstrate a proactive approach to troubleshooting, a willingness to learn, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced technology environment.

From a technical perspective, the candidate should demonstrate knowledge of IT application support, troubleshooting, incident management, ticketing systems, application installation and configuration, workstation support, software maintenance, patching, anti-virus management, and basic IT systems administration.

jobs.description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

YOUR MISSION

Real-Time Operations keeps Glovo’s deliveries moving: when an order stalls, a courier stops, or a store goes quiet, RTO is what notices and acts.

Your mission is to find what is actually causing those failures and then build the thing that fixes them — the analysis and the automation, not one handed to someone else to build.

You will work at the intersection of operations analytics, AI agent quality and automation engineering, on problems that are genuinely unsolved.

THE JOURNEY

-
Own operational analyses end to end — take an ambiguous problem, find the real driver rather than the most visible symptom, and turn it into a decision about where to focus.

-
Build and run the automations that come out of that analysis: real-time detection, the action it triggers, the monitoring that proves it still works, and the documentation someone else can operate it from.

-
Work on the systems around our AI voice and chat agents across fourteen markets — automated conversation audits, the loop that turns an unanswered question into a knowledge base update, and the evaluation that says whether a prompt change helped or hurt.

-
Design and read the experiments behind what we ship: choose the unit of randomisation, pick the metric that reflects the real outcome, and report the result honestly, including when it says the thing does not work.

-
Build processes that send an input to an LLM and need a specific, reliable output back — together with the checks that confirm the output is what we expected.

-
Hand findings to the right owner when they sit outside RTO, with enough evidence that they can act on them.
jobs.requirements_raw:

Advanced SQL — window functions, CTEs, joining across large event and transactional tables, and the habit of checking what a column really contains before building on it.

A structured, sceptical approach to problem-solving. You look for the reason your own conclusion might be wrong before someone else does.

-
Hands-on experience building something end to end that ran in production and that other people depended on.

-
Good written and verbal English. Most of your stakeholders are operations people, not analysts.

Nice to have

Python (pandas or equivalent), experiment analysis, BigQuery, n8n or similar orchestration, Google Apps Script, Looker, voice or chat AI agent platforms such as ElevenLabs, and a background in last-mile delivery, marketplaces or logistics.

Practical experience using LLMs inside a process that had to produce a reliable output — prompt design, structured outputs, and a way of checking the result.

jobs.description:
Job Ref ID: JR0080820

Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Romania is one of Glovo's biggest markets and one drawing real attention from regional and HQ. The GM is hiring a Strategy & Operations Lead who plays Chief of Staff to the GM. This is the operator who sits next to them, makes the country run, and owns the cross functional projects that decide whether the next two years are step change or grind.

Here's the honest version of the job.

Romania has the usual problems of a country that scaled fast: the operating cadence is patchy, decisions sit too long, and the same handful of cross functional issues keep coming back because nobody owns them end to end. You're here to fix that. You'll have the GM's full backing, the country leadership team in the room with you weekly, and direct lines into HQ and regional. The work is high leverage and visible. What you do or don't do shows up in country numbers within a quarter.

This is not a strategy role. About 70% of it is operational: running the cadence, prepping the GM, making sure decisions actually get made, holding function leads to what they committed, pushing the GM's projects to the line. The other 30% is hard problem solving on those projects. The kind that doesn't have a published playbook, because Romania's market is its own thing.

If "I want to do strategy" is the appeal, you'll hate this. If "I want to run something real, at scale, next to where the decisions get made" is the appeal, keep reading.

What lands on your desk: numbers that don't tie, a stalled cross functional project, a leadership meeting where the wrong call is about to get made, a regional review the GM is walking into with the wrong narrative. You decide what gets fixed first, and you fix it. In the spreadsheet and in the room, often in the same hour.

What you get back: every part of a country that matters seen from the inside, daily contact with the people running it, cross functional reps that don't exist inside any single function, and the seat closest to where the decisions get made.

THE JOURNEY

Run the country's operating rhythm

- Own the weekly review, MBR, QBR, and leadership team routines: make sure they drive decisions, not just slides

- Build the reporting layer that catches problems on Monday, not at the end of the month

- When something's off, get on it: surface it within 48 hours with a root cause and a proposed fix

- Drive the calls the GM hasn't made yet, then make sure each one gets executed

- Be the person the GM trusts to know what's actually happening on the ground

Drive cross functional projects end to end

- Take the GM's projects from ambiguous brief to delivered outcome

- Frame the problem, build the plan, run the room, land the result

- Do the work yourself when you need to: the analysis, the stakeholder call, the slide

jobs.title: Data Analyst (Quick Commerce & Partnerships)
jobs.description:
foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

As a Data Analyst in the Quick Commerce & Partnerships Analytics team, you will be part of our mission to drive impactful decisions and incremental value across our 16 markets. You'll support the team by conducting deep-dive analyses, maintaining data consistency and providing high-quality strategic insights that drive decisions on key quick commerce levers — from dark store expansion and assortment changes to delivery fee adjustments and discounting. This is a foundational role offering the opportunity to grow technical skills, gain exposure to high-impact projects, and learn from experienced data professionals who work on big problems at a global scale, leveraging the latest AI tools and analytical techniques.

- Quick Commerce Analysis: Utilize analytical methodologies ranging from data modeling to descriptive/predictive/prescriptive analytics in order to measure incremental impact and make actionable recommendations on quick commerce investments (e.g. dark store expansion, assortment changes, delivery fee adjustments, discounting), customer conversion funnel, cost/margin optimization, and tactical execution of quick commerce initiatives.

- Data Modeling & Measurement: Build and refine measurement frameworks and metric definitions for key quick commerce initiatives (e.g. Shops, dark store performance, fulfillment/delivery metrics); support the development of SQL models to implement frameworks and transform massive datasets into actionable insights using tools like BigQuery (SQL), Excel, and dbt.

- Strategic Reporting & Visualization: Build compelling, user-friendly data assets including both traditional dashboards (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and agentic solutions (e.g. root-cause analysis agents for delivery delays or stockouts) that facilitate decision-making for business operators and leaders.

- Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with quick commerce, operations, and supply chain partners to understand strategic objectives, recommend analytics solutions, and present insights effectively. Also, work closely with senior analysts and team leads, learning from their approach to data modeling, visualization, and storytelling.

- Data Quality & Tracking: Monitor data quality and participate in QA processes to ensure consistency across all reporting metrics.

- AI-Driven Analytics & Automation: Evaluate and implement AI-powered solutions that transform how quick commerce analytics operates — including agentic workflows (e.g. root-cause analysis agents, automated anomaly detection on delivery/fulfillment metrics), LLM-assisted insight generation, and prompt-engineered pipelines. Help translate repeatable analyst workflows into scalable AI tools, and share knowledge across the team.

Find out more about our Data Analytics folks here:

- Turn insights into impact!

- Looking for a career in data analytics? This could be the opportunity for you!
jobs.requirements_raw:
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Overall 2-4 years of experience in data analytics. Experience supporting Quick Commerce, Operations, Supply Chain, or Commercial teams (online or offline retail), or similar, is an advantage.

- 2+ years of proficiency in SQL and experience with at least one data visualization tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau). Familiarity with dbt is a plus.

- Strong communication skills, with an ability to present findings in a clear and concise way to various levels of business partners.

- A team-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges.

- Solid background in statistical analysis and data modeling is an advantage.

- Interest in AI solutions and their applications in analytics is an advantage.
